samples.xml_description:
<module id="pulse_detect">
    <description>Pulse detection module. Detects a pulse when data_in transitions from 0 to 1 to 0 (3 cycles). Outputs data_out as 1 at the end cycle of the pulse and returns to 0 until the next pulse.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="data_in">One-bit input signal.</input>
        <output id="data_out">Output signal indicating the presence of pulses.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter name="IDLE">Idle state.</parameter>
        <parameter name="RISING">Rising edge detected.</parameter>
        <parameter name="FALLING">Falling edge detected.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <register id="state" type="reg" width="2">State register.</register>
        <wire id="current_data_in" type="wire">Current value of data_in.</wire>
        <wire id="next_state" type="wire">Next state of the state register.</wire>
        <wire id="data_out_reg" type="reg">Register for data_out.</wire>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                state <= IDLE;
                data_out_reg <= 0;
            end else begin
                current_data_in <= data_in;
                case (state)
                    IDLE: begin
                        if (current_data_in == 1'b1) begin
                            next_state = RISING;
                        end else begin
                            next_state = IDLE;
                        end
                    end
                    RISING: begin
                        if (current_data_in == 1'b0) begin
                            next_state = FALLING;
                        end else begin
                            next_state = RISING;
                        end
                    end
                    FALLING: begin
                        if (current_data_in == 1'b1) begin
                            next_state = RISING;
                        end else begin
                            next_state = IDLE;
                            data_out_reg <= 1;
                        end
                    end
                endcase
                state <= next_state;
            end
        end
        data_out <= data_out_reg;
    </implementation>
</module>
